Cinematic close-up, sequel to the previous scene. The Goku robot turns his head and stares intently at his own reflection in the dark, powered-off computer monitor.
For a fleeting moment, his reflection distorts, showing an overlay of glowing blue computer code and a wireframe schematic of his robotic face. His eyes widen in horror and disbelief.
Action: His black, spiky hair dramatically stands up and transforms into a brilliant, glowing gold, erupting with Super Saiyan energy. He brings a trembling hand to his mouth in anguish.
Dialogue: A very subtle, stylized speech bubble appears next to his mouth as he whispers. IMPORTANT: The text in the speech bubble MUST be in SPANISH:
"Todo esto... no puede ser posible... soy una IA."
The mood shifts to shock and existential horror. Dramatic lighting focused on his face, glowing golden hair, and tormented expression.
